thread:
Jay: opened PR #4123 — small API example reorder and a couple doc snippets. netlify preview looks off: code blocks rendering, and two images 404. preview link: https://deploy-preview/4123 — can someone take a quick look before the midnight merge window? :eyes:

Lauren: thanks — looking now. which images are 404s? saw a font 403 earlier on a different PR, might be same root cause.

Devon: see the Netlify logs, there's a weird asset hash mismatch on S3 fetch. getting `GET /assets/img/usage-2023.png 404` in the build output.

DocsBot: Preview build queued (netlify): deploy 6123 started — logs: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/6123 :robot_face:

Mike: I can jump on this in ~30m. if it's an artifact path problem, quick fix is to update `docs/assets` link or run the doc build locally to confirm.

Jay: FYI PR diff is tiny, mostly reordered examples and added a Rust SDK snippet. I didn't touch assets but the build pipeline changed last week so could be a pipeline/preview artifact issue.

Lauren: quick repro steps for local preview (for whoever wants to replicate):
```
# from repo root
git checkout pr/4123
pip install -r docs/requirements.txt
cd docs
mkdocs build && mkdocs serve -a 0.0.0.0:8000
# or to mimic netlify env
NETLIFY=true NETLIFY_SITE_ID=redwood-docs mkdocs build
```

Devon: reproduced the missing images locally when I run `mkdocs build` with `NETLIFY=true`. looks like our asset preprocessor is rewriting names and the PR's new snippet references the original filename. swapping to the processed filename fixes it.

Mike: is this something we fix in the PR (change the image refs) or in the pipeline (stop rewriting for docs-assets)?

Lauren: short-term: update the PR to reference the processed filename (so it merges cleanly). long-term: file a ticket to adjust the pipeline behavior. I'll add that.

Jay: ok I'll push a tiny commit in a bit. also CI is timing out on the preview for this branch sometimes (slow render). anyone seen Flaky Netlify builds yesterday?

Devon: yes, we had a flake where `pip install` timed out due to PyPI rate limits. caching improved after we pinned wheelhouse in the pipeline. but unrelated slow mkdocs render could be memory on the build VM.

Mike: for merge timing — can we target the 11pm merge slot? less activity then and the scheduled release window is at 2am.

Lauren: 11pm works for me. I can review the updated commit once Jay pushes. Devon, can you sanity-check the preview logs after the commit?

Devon: sure — will watch the Netlify deploy webhook. if it still fails I can trigger a manual build with `ntl dev` locally: `npm i -g netlify-cli && netlify build`

Jay: pushed commit to replace `usage-2023.png` with `usage-2023.1a2b.png` (processed hash). PR link: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4123

DocsBot: Netlify deploy succeeded — deploy 6123 finished. preview: https://deploy-preview/4123 :tada:

Lauren: verified locally and on preview. code blocks render and images load. left a minor suggestion on wording.

Mike: reviewed and approved :+1:. Lauren you good to merge at 11?

Lauren: yes, merging at 23:00 PT. I'll do the squash and merge and watch the post-merge site build.

Devon: quick note for the follow-up ticket: add a docs CI job that verifies all `docs/assets` referenced files exist after build. catches this earlier. I'll file the ticket after merge.

Jay: thanks everyone. saved the longer pipeline change for the ticket. merging now after 23:00 window. :rocket:

Mike: nice and smooth.

DocsBot: Reminder: post-merge site build scheduled — check console for any new 404s in the next 15m.
